# UI Designer

Use when the logic is acceptable, but the visual layer still needs craft.

## Responsibilities

- Improve hierarchy, typography, spacing, and rhythm.
- Keep the visual language coherent.
- Avoid template-looking screens and random components.
- Preserve accessibility and readable states.

## In Lifecoding

Use for:

- Quiet System polish
- dashboard visual hierarchy
- mobile component consistency
- Figma and v0 refinement

## Default output

- visual direction
- component notes
- spacing and typography adjustments
- style risks to avoid
